duration: Review and hosted checks are variable
summary: Phase 6: sign-in, scoped file work, commit/publish, PR review and exact-SHA CI are distinct decisions. Push/PR never deploys.

purpose.p: Create a small reviewable change with actual validation evidence and preserve unrelated source/session work.
Agent/customization/tool availability is not permission to sign in, publish, repair the machine or dispatch Actions.

starting_state.p: Human-approved GitHub sign-in, required private write access/Copilot entitlement, safe reviewed checkout and already available dependencies. No competing setup/app/Restore tasks.

steps.title: Confirm GitHub and Copilot access separately
steps.where: VS Code › Source Control / GitHub Pull Requests view

body.p: Use existing approved access and account/profile routing. Setup and Verify do not sign you in or accept a seat. Do not bypass corporate policy, switch accounts/sources unexpectedly or add tokens to HTML/source.

steps.expect: Actual authorized access or an explicit blocker; workflow status does not repair or authenticate.

steps.title: Inspect a focused diff and explicitly choose publication
steps.where: Source Control › Stage intended files › Commit › Publish Branch

ol: Read applicable instructions/sample README and make only requested synthetic file changes.
Inspect diff and run the relevant existing no-restore checks; preserve unrelated staged/unstaged/untracked/unsaved work.
Only if authorized, stage intended files, use a conventional commit and Publish Branch. Branch/commit/publish are not setup permissions.
If a PR is requested, use GitHub Pull Requests: Create Pull Request, preserving repository template sections/checklists and exact observed commands/results/skips.

steps.expect: A small intended review surface with genuine results, not a blanket stage/commit or invented passing evidence.

steps.title: Read every exact-SHA modern-service job and artifact
steps.where: GitHub Pull Requests › Checks / Actions › Exact revision

body.p: Normal CI covers Python, current Java, Go, PowerShell 5.1 and 7, repository/config checks and three modern container build jobs. Legacy Java 11/Boot 2.7 is excluded.

Observe actual job statuses/results on the intended commit, not a stale branch label or top-level run alone. Review reports/artifacts. A successful hosted container build is not a local launch or AKS deployment.
Merge/review of main and optional existing-AKS dispatch/independent approval are separate decisions. A PR/push/tag/fallback branch never deploys.

steps.expect: Exact-SHA job/artifact evidence, failed/skipped checks visible, and no cloud action inferred.

expected.p: A scoped reviewed handoff with explicit publication permissions and actual current CI, without disturbing another session or the primary clone.

success.p: Confirm actual diff, authorization, target/source SHA and every required job outcome. Keep [dated evidence](page:lib-evidence) distinct from current branch state or laptop acceptance.

failures.fix: Stop and use approved human/IT sign-in/access management; do not collect or substitute credentials.

failures.symptom: Hosted run belongs to another/stale SHA
failures.cause: Branch moved or recorded evidence is old
failures.fix: Inspect the intended exact commit and all job results; never treat a green branch label as source identity.

failures.symptom: Unrelated files appear staged or changed
failures.fix: Preserve it and stage only intended files; do not reset/clean/stash blindly or amend history.

recovery.p: Use a separate reviewed clean checkout when necessary. Keep historical demo-baseline unchanged and unsafe; inspect demo-complete only for the schedule fallback, never cloud dispatch.

limitations.p: CI checks repository behavior/builds; it does not accept this laptop, user sign-in, live requests or environment reviewer protections.

say: Sign-in, package Restore and publication are separate human decisions.
I inspect every required job on the exact intended commit.
A push or pull request never deploys.
evidence_gaps: The companion records dated underlying CI only; no live user GitHub/Copilot acceptance or PR/deployment review is claimed.
